declare
 temp_id VARCHAR2(10);
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 if :s_customer_id is not null
 then
 begin
 select customer_id into temp_id
 from customers
 where customer_id = :s_customer_id
 and customer_type != 'PA'
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from orders
 where customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 select customer_id into temp_id
 from customers
 where name like :s_customer_id || '%'
 and customer_type != 'PA'
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from orders
 where customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 list_values;
 return;
 end;
 end;
 :s_customer_id := temp_id;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 show_error_dist('0302');
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** Modified on 05/08/2011; IM:5412; AV; Modified cursor to add date fields as parameters (to implement timezone requirement)
*/
procedure get_pending_order is
 cursor c1(pl_from_date IN DATE, pl_to_date IN DATE) is
 select distinct orders.chapter_id chapter_id,
 order_no,
 substr(ordstat.code_desc,1,10) order_status_desc,
 substr(customers.name, 1, 20) customer,
 decode(orders.order_class,'ST','STAT','AS','ASAP',
 'RE','REGULAR','SO','STANDING',
 '**') order_class_desc,
 insert_date,
 order_status,
 decode(orders.order_class,'ST',1,'AS',2,'RE',3,4)
 from orders, customers, vserv_order_status ordstat
 where orders.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and customers.customer_id =
 nvl(:s_customer_id,customers.customer_id)
 and customers.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and ordstat.code = orders.order_status
 and trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, insert_date)) between pl_from_date and pl_to_date -- IM 10366 lifetrack_timezone_convert added.
 and sysdate between ordstat.eff_Date
 and nvl(ordstat.term_date,sysdate)
 and orders.order_status =
 nvl(:s_order_status,orders.order_status)
 and orders.order_type = nvl(:s_order_type,orders.order_type)
 -- and orders.order_class <> 'ER'
 and orders.order_class = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_order_class, orders.order_class)
 order by 8, 7 DESC, 6, 2;
 
 v_local_time timestamp;
 -- Added on 05/08/2012; AV; IM:5412
 v_from_date DATE;
 v_to_date DATE; 
 ---

begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 -- commneted by Edwin on 08/07/11 as the insert date is stored as local date
 
 /*if is_timezone_enabled then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :from_date, v_from_date);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :to_date, v_to_date); 
 else
 v_from_date := :from_date;
 v_to_date := :to_date;
 end if; 
 */
 
 v_from_date := :from_date;
 v_to_date := :to_date; 

 
 for c1_rec in c1(v_from_date, v_to_date)
 loop
 ---
 :order_info.order_no := c1_rec.order_no;
 :order_status_desc := c1_rec.order_status_desc;
 :customer_name := c1_rec.customer;
 :priority := c1_rec.order_class_desc;
 
 :s_hour_old := substr(to_char((sysdate-c1_rec.insert_Date)*24),1,5); -- IM 10336
 :order_date := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, c1_rec.insert_Date); -- IM 10336
 
 -- Commented below two on 01/20/2015; -- IM 10336
 --:order_date := c1_rec.insert_Date; -- IM 10336
 --:s_hour_old := substr(to_char((sysdate-:order_date)*24),1,5); -- IM10336
 
 -- below code by Jairam Kulkarni to convert GMT to local time
 -- on 24-Mar-2011
 /* if is_timezone_enabled then commented by Edwin 
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :order_date, v_local_time);
 :order_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :order_date := :order_date;
 end if;
 */
 
 -- Above code by jairam



 down;

 end loop;
 clear_record;
 first_record;
 :s_order_indicator := '>';
 

 
end;
